title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE SECOND 4K PASS
why: The card was stamped v21.28 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. Its new second line names the fixes from the second 4K screenshot pass of 2026-10-09 (v21.29 to v21.42); the rest are in the change list.
now: The what is new card names the second 4K pass.
